parsed.note_claim: The woman who brandished a knife at the Rain Rave Water Music Festival was Shannon Anne-Ooi, who was charged and referred for psychiatric evaluation due to suspected mental health issues.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: the accused, 28-year-old Shannon Anne-Ooi, has been ordered to undergo psychiatric evaluation at Hospital Bahagia in Ulu Kinta, Perak, as she is suspected of having mental health issues.
parsed.reason: The page directly identifies the woman as Shannon Anne-Ooi, confirms she was charged at the Sessions Court, and states she was referred for psychiatric evaluation due to suspected mental health issues, all of which substantiate the note's claims.
